title: Waiting for Parts and Repairs
summary: This topic centers on customers waiting for parts, repairs, or shop diagnosis, with most examples describing status updates rather than clear evaluations.

positive.summary: One positive review says the vehicle operated normally after an alert and reported no starting issues.

negative.summary: One negative review describes the vehicle being in the shop for diagnosis and repair of the issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly report waiting for parts, repairs, or supplier items without enough sentiment detail to classify them more clearly.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined status updates, so clear customer sentiment is often not available.
The examples mix repair delays, parts availability, shop status, and requests for accessories, so the topic is somewhat heterogeneous.
Some fragments reference other brands or products, which limits confidence that all examples reflect the same underlying issue.
